Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning value-added uses of ovine blood.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to value-added uses of ovine blood; and amendingRCW 16.68.170.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 16.68.170 and 1949 c 100 s 17 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The director is authorized and shall make and enforce suchregulations as may be necessary to effectuate the provisions of thischapter. Such regulations shall be consistent with the provisions ofthis chapter. (2) The rules adopted under this section should provide, ifpracticable, for alternative disposal options for ovine blood, separatefrom the carcass or associated processing wastes, other than deliveryto a rendering plant if alternative disposal options can deliver avalueadded property to the blood.
